reason: I'd probably use the free visit, but $15 a trip is hard on our budget when the library and the park cost nothing. I'd need to see my toddler is safe before I'd pay for repeat visits.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? A gated Baby Nook helps on paper, but 25 kids is a lot, and $15 a visit adds up fast on one income plus shift work.
would_change_my_mind: A visit during a quiet slot that shows the Baby Nook really keeps the little ones separate, plus a drop-in price closer to $8-10 or a cheap pack.
